Name: Feminine Female Farmer
Author: HyperChicken01
Description:
This is my most ambitious project yet. A full base sprite overhaul for the female farmer!

Most animations should work with no issues, however, I am unsure of the very few uncommon ones (Harp and Candles?), as I have not discovered them yet to test in-game. I attempted this to see if a full player sprite overhaul could be possible and to make a more feminine looking female character. The sprite is fully customisable; hair, skin tone, shirt, skirt, boots, eye colour, etc.

I have included alternate versions of the Base Sprite Overhaul and an alternate Shirt Overhaul, comparison images are in the screenshots section. You can also play as Haley, which I used as my test sprite if you like.


If there are any issues at all, let me know and I'll try my best to get it fixed as soon as possible.

[i]
[/i][u]Installation:[/u]

You can only use [b]ONE[/b] Base Sprite Overhaul and [b]ONE[/b] Shirt Overhaul at a time, so pick the ones you prefer. :)

Don't forget to make a backup of the original .xnb files before overwriting.

Readme.txt is included with instructions on how to install.
